nodes.label: Park Tool TM-1 Conversion Table Data
nodes.norm_label: park tool tm-1 conversion table data

nodes.label: UUID Primary Keys
nodes.rationale: All records use UUID strings from utils.generate_uuid(), never auto-increment, for robust unique identifiers.

nodes.label: HTMX Partial Updates
nodes.rationale: Partial page updates without full reload for component selection and tension reading badges.

nodes.label: Quality Status Logic (Industry Standards)
nodes.rationale: Well Balanced (<5% std dev, none >10%), Needs Truing (5-10%), Uneven Tension (>10% or spokes >20%), Out of Range (outside spoke type limits).
nodes.source_location: Tension Tracking System > Quality Status Logic

nodes.label: Radar Charts (tension visualization)
nodes.rationale: Chart.js radar charts show tension distribution around the wheel (blue=left, purple=right, red=max recommended).

nodes.label: Deviation Tracking (Dual Approach)
nodes.rationale: average_deviation_status (+/-20% threshold) is stored and rewritten for ALL readings on any change to avoid stale data and allow queries; deviation_pct is computed on the fly for display only, with color-coded badges refreshed via HTMX.

nodes.label: Session Independence
nodes.rationale: Each session has its own readings, averages and deviation percentages so editing or fixing one session never affects others; supports editing an active session for weeks then starting a new one after riding.

nodes.label: Park Tool TM-1 Conversion System
nodes.rationale: Industry-standard tension meter calibration; conversion_table.txt maps TM-1 readings 0-40 to kgf per spoke type, with linear interpolation.
nodes.source_location: Key Features > Park Tool TM-1 Conversion System

nodes.label: Progressive Build Creation
nodes.rationale: Builds need only a name; components can be filled in later, so partial builds are allowed.

nodes.label: Spoke Length Calculation
nodes.rationale: Left and right lengths computed separately because hub flanges are asymmetric; formula sqrt((R - r cos a)^2 + offset^2 + (r sin a)^2) - nipple_length.

nodes.label: Component Locking
nodes.rationale: Components used by a wheel build cannot be edited or deleted, preserving build history integrity; implemented via get_builds_using_*() in database_manager.py.

nodes.label: Docker Deployment (create-container-wheelbuilder.sh)
nodes.rationale: No docker-compose; script stops/removes old container and image, rebuilds, and mounts ~/code/container_data for persistence.

nodes.label: Logging Guidelines (standard logging, no logger.py)
nodes.rationale: Every module uses logging.getLogger(__name__) with consistent level semantics (info=lifecycle/CRUD, debug=diagnostics, warning=non-critical, error=failures). Unified format via uvicorn_log_config.ini, dual stdout+rotating file output (3 x 10KB).

nodes.label: Single-User Per Instance (no auth)
nodes.rationale: No authentication for simpler self-hosted deployment.

nodes.label: SQLite Database Storage
nodes.rationale: Lightweight file-based DB, easy backup; stored at ~/code/container_data/wheel_builder.db, shared between local dev (via ./data symlink) and Docker volume mount.

nodes.label: Strict Three-Layer Architecture
nodes.rationale: main.py routes only, business_logic.py holds all calculations and orchestration and must go through database_manager.py, which alone touches Peewee models. Keeps boundaries clean; violating them is explicitly forbidden.

nodes.label: Hobby Project Disclaimer
nodes.rationale: Not affiliated with Park Tool or manufacturers; users should double-check calculations with professional tools.
